Near the end of the camp, Biko Pegasus 
received a rivalry declaration from Hishi 
Akebono. Fired up for their upcoming 
match, she resolved not to lose.

Meanwhile, the action actor watched the 
race from abroad, stating that Biko 
Pegasus's heroics served as the driving 
force behind their own spirit.

Determined not to lose to the two of them, 
Biko Pegasus enthusiastically took on the 
Centaur Stakes!
